name: Sarah McGregor
title: Psychologist
description: For more than 30 years, I have worked in community and specialist sexual assault and family violence services, supporting adults, children, young people, and families who have experienced trauma. My areas of expertise include sexual assault, childhood sexual abuse, family violence, online abuse and the impacts of complex trauma. I provide individual counselling, clinical supervision, and EMDR consultation for therapists and other helping professionals.I am also a board approved supervisor. Areas of practice: Trauma, Depression, Anxiety, Complicated grief, Dissociative disorders, Sexual or Physical abuse.
specialties: EMDR, Trauma, Depression, Anxiety, Complicated grief, Dissociative disorders, Sexual or Physical abuse

name: Mish Kumar-Jonson
title: Social Worker
description: Mish Kumar-Jonson (they/them) is a South Indian, non-binary, queer, neurodivergent, and disabled Accredited Mental Health Social Worker and EMDR Consultant based on unceded Kulin Nation lands. Mish specialises in EMDR therapy with neurodivergent and queer folks and those navigating intergenerational and systemic trauma, particularly individuals from the global majority. Their work integrates identity-affirming, person centred, culturally humble, and healing-centred approaches within the EMDR framework. name: Aneta Kotevski
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Aneta is an accredited EMDR practitioner and a member of the EMDR Association of Australia. She is trained in both EMDR and Schema Therapy and has extensive expertise in working with Complex Trauma and PTSD, Mood and Anxiety Disorders, Dissociative Disorders, chronic pain, and psychological adjustment to medical illness and life transitions. Aneta understands that meeting a psychologist for the first time — or transitioning to a new one — can feel daunting.
